 ======

 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order
2 02-12-2025 Heard Ms. Shashi Priya, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel representing the State.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the grant of following relief(s):
"for directing the respondents to pay compensation amount to the petitioners for the land acquired by the District Land Acquisition Officer, Sitamarhi bearing Khata No.
543, Khesra No. 1587, Rakwa acquired-0.142 hectare situated on NH-77 under the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of the Section 3A of the National Highways Act,
1956 (48 of 1956) for the purposes of stretching the National Highway."
Patna High Court CWJC No.23478 of 2018(2) dt.02-12-2025 I.A. No. 01 of 2024 3.

The aforesaid Interlocutory Application has been preferred to expunge the name of respondent no.3, namely Satya Narayan Sahni and to be substituted by the heirs as recorded in paragraph no.3 of the petition.
4. It has been incorporated that Satya Narayan Sahni died on 10.02.2024.
